description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Urtet's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Myr Retriever and the Myr token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {3}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may forego sacrificing the Myr tokens.
